body:
Found in task:2414798176c466e4, run af333848436847ab, steps 92 and 94.

1. **A `#[cfg(test)]` helper outside the tests is treated as a test.** `crate.with_root` is a `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate) fn` at the crate root, used by tests in `board`, `drafts`, `lockdown`, `mcp` and the crate. When it moved to `cli`, it went into the private `cli::tests` module, and every caller was rewritten to `crate::cli::tests::with_root`. That broke 21 sites. A `#[cfg(test)]` item outside a `mod tests` should move as an ordinary item. Only test containers and `#[test]` functions belong in `<module>_tests.rs` (D-206).
2. **Items declared inside `thread_local!` can't be named.** `UNTESTED` and `TEST_ROOT` are declared inside the crate root's `thread_local!` blocks. `view crate.UNTESTED` replies *unknown name*, the outline shows only `thread_local!`, and moved code that uses `UNTESTED` (`cli.batch`, `cli.reset_after_panic`) was left with no import. As a minimum, moved code that uses such an item must get a path to it. Whether each `thread_local!` item becomes its own symbol is the worker's call; say which in the outcome.

### Done when

- A unit test moves a `#[cfg(test)]` helper that tests in other modules use. It lands as an ordinary item, and its callers type-check.
- A unit test moves a function that uses an item declared in `thread_local!`, and the result type-checks.
- `check --warnings`, `rust-unit` and the extract acceptance suite pass.
title: extract: test-only helpers and thread_local items
